messages:
mira (oncall): heads up — 5xx spike on /v2/prompt-route-new since ~T-3m. Canary traffic is failing fast.
incident-bot: Paging @mira (oncall) @kevin @jessica — incident severity P1 detected (error-rate > 12% over 1m). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prompt-routing
kevin: I'm on it. quick check: which variant rolled?
jessica: experimental mux endpoint (promptv2-experiment) got 10% canary at 09:40UTC. saw increased latency then errors.
tom (product): customers on the beta list may be impacted, flag id fg-promptv2-2026-09. hold customer-facing comms until we know.
mira (oncall): first mitigation: flip the feature flag to stable route (kill the experimental). Can someone confirm flag toggle path?
kevin: I can flip via the FF UI, but let's use the safe API so it's auditable. Command: `curl -X POST https://ff.redwood/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"fg-promptv2-2026-09","state":"off","actor":"oncall"}'`
jessica: I'll validate traffic routes after. Also preparing to scale down canary units to zero.
incident-bot: Action logged: toggle-request created by mira (oncall). Incident ID INC-3598765432.
pagerduty: Pager duty note: oncall alerted at 09:43:12 UTC.
mira (oncall): executing toggle now.
kevin: saw the API call come through. UI shows flag state: `off` for experiment.
jessica: confirming — traffic shift started, canary pool draining. latency dropping on prod-proxy-3.
support-bot: Notifying impacted beta customers using template: "We're aware of degraded performance for experimental routing and have switched traffic to stable. Monitoring..." Approving send?
tom (product): yes send the prepared note. Keep it factual, no timeline yet.
kevin: quick note — logs show null pointer in prompt-router v2 handler around the new endpoint. Likely regression in header parsing.
mira (oncall): good to know. We should block any re-roll of that image until a fix. Patch-ops: tag image `no-rollout-block`.
jessica: running health checks across regions; eu-west looks clear, us-west had most errors.
incident-bot: Canary count: was 12 -> 0 in 45s. Error-rate falling to 0.8% over 2m window.
mira (oncall): handing off to kevin for postmortem and rollback validation. I'm on escalations for customers. @kevin you're lead now — please confirm takeover.
kevin: confirmed. I'll keep this thread as lead and create a postmortem ticket once we stabilize. Steps next: root cause debug, cherry-pick fix, QA, staged redeploy.
tom (product): priority: customer impact assessment + whether to pause further promptv2 experiments.
kevin: I'll capture the flag id, image tag, and error logs. Quick log snippet: ```
ERROR [prompt-router] null pointer deref at header.h:42
stack: router->parse_headers->allocate_kv
```
jessica: repro attempt in staging failed (no NPE) — suggests data-specific input in canary. Collect sample requests from failing instances.
support-bot: Message sent to impacted customers at 09:48UTC. Template used: "We've reverted experimental prompt routing for your workspace. We'll share more in the follow-up"
mira (oncall): customer Slack channel #cust-beta-alert updated.
incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Error budget restored to acceptable levels. Still monitoring for 30m.
kevin: I'll keep the flag off and block PR merges to that route until we have a patch. Creating safety guard in CI: require integration test for header parsing.
tom (product): agree. Also want a rollback play document for future canaries: add steps to auto-kill flag and reroute traffic within 60s.
jessica: adding an alert tweak to route-error-rate so we get earlier notice next time (threshold lower).
mira (oncall): handing back to SRE rota; if anything resurfaces ping me. Incident closed for paging after handoff at 10:05UTC.
kevin: creating INC-3598765432-PR for postmortem + customer impact summary. Will include timeline, root cause hypothesis, and next actions.
incident-bot: Postmortem ticket created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-3598765432
support-bot: Drafting follow-up comms with customer success; expected update in 2h.
tom (product): thanks all. nice quick flip. Keep changes minimal until root cause confirmed.
mira (oncall): closing thread — please move follow-ups to the postmortem ticket. ::done:: :white_check_mark:
